subject: math
cluster: Apply geometric concepts in modeling situations
skillName: Density in Area and Volume Models
intro: Density is an amount per unit of area or volume. Population density is people per unit area: $\text{density}=\frac{\text{population}}{\text{area}}$. Mass density is mass per unit volume: $\text{density}=\frac{\text{mass}}{\text{volume}}$. Rearranging, amount $=$ density $\times$ size. These let us compare how crowded or concentrated things are and estimate totals.

items.prompt: A town has $12{,}000$ people in $4$ square miles. Find the population density.

steps: Population density is population divided by area.
So the density is $3000$ people per square mile.

items.prompt: A metal block has mass $90$ g and volume $30$ cubic cm. Find its density.

steps: Mass density is mass divided by volume.
So the density is $3$ g per cubic cm.

items.prompt: A region has density $500$ people per square mile over $6$ square miles. Estimate the population.
Write the formula for population density.

steps: It is people per unit area.

items.prompt: Write the formula for mass density.

steps: It is mass per unit volume.
